subject: OrbitCare - AWS co-sell kickoff: mutual action plan & procurement timeline
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: megan.liu@amazon.com, samir.patel@orbitcare.health
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrbitCare - AWS co-sell kickoff: mutual action plan & procurement timeline

Megan / Samir —

Thanks for taking this on. OrbitCare is evaluating an LLM-based clinical documentation assistant and is interested in a marketplace + co-sell path with AWS. I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a short procurement checklist to kick off alignment.

High-level asks:
- Megan: can you introduce us to the AWS commercial contact who owns marketplace co-sell approvals in US West? We want to confirm the co-sell qualification steps and timeline.
- Samir: please confirm your procurement contact and any internal timeline constraints (procurement window, contracting lead times).
- Karthik (cc): I’d like you to lead the joint account plan and own technical pre-sales coordination.

Proposed next step: 30 min kickoff with the three of us + AWS to map the MAP and procurement path. Suggested slots: Wed 5/8 10–10:30 PT or Thu 5/9 11–11:30 PT.

Attachments: [OrbitCare-MAP-draft-v1.pdf] [procurement-checklist.xlsx]

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: megan.liu@amazon.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, samir.patel@orbitcare.health
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitCare - AWS co-sell kickoff: mutual action plan & procurement timeline

Hi Lauren / Samir —

Happy to help. I've looped in our AWS field BD for the West region (internal) and can act as the partner BD to shepherd the co-sell qualification. Quick notes:
- AWS will want a completed MAP + proof-of-concept plan and a procurement owner for Marketplace listing approvals.
- Typical timeline for co-sell enablement is ~3–6 weeks once we have both the MAP and procurement owner confirmed, but we can accelerate if procurement can commit to an internal review window.

Samir — can you introduce your procurement lead? Also, Wed 5/8 10:00 PT works for me — please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (MAP review, procurement checklist, next-owner assignments).

—Megan
Megan Liu
Partner Business Development, AWS
megan.liu@amazon.com

From: samir.patel@orbitcare.health
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, megan.liu@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitCare - AWS co-sell kickoff: mutual action plan & procurement timeline

Thanks Lauren / Megan —

Looping in Sophie Grant (cc) who runs procurement at OrbitCare. Sophie, we are looking to get Redwood on AWS Marketplace and do a co-sell engagement; Megan will help with the AWS steps. Can we do Wed 5/8 10:00 PT for a 30-min kickoff? If not, Thu 5/9 11:00 PT also works.

Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@orbitcare.health> (Procurement)

Sophie, I attached our standard procurement intake form — happy to fill any additional fields prior to the meeting.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product, OrbitCare
samir.patel@orbitcare.health

[Attachment: orbitcare_procurement_intake.pdf]
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: megan.liu@amazon.com, samir.patel@orbitcare.health, sophie.grant@orbitcare.health
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitCare - AWS co-sell kickoff: mutual action plan & procurement timeline

Lauren / Jonas —

Quick internal coordination before the kickoff:
- Jonas: can you own the solution-map slide (3–4 mins) to show the integration path (OrbitCare EHR -> Redwood inference runtime -> Marketplace deployment)? We should highlight data flow, privacy controls (VPC option), and expected latency for typical encounter workloads.
- Lauren: confirm any hard SLOs OrbitCare expects (p95 latency target, throughput). That will inform whether we recommend Dedicated vs hosted.
- I'll prepare a short co-sell runbook and the target ask for AWS (co-sell enablement, promo listing, and potential credits).

If we want to shorten the meeting, I can push the technical deep-dive to a follow-up with Jonas + OrbitCare engineering. For kickoff, focus on procurement owners, MAP approvals, and next milestones.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — calendar invite sent for Wed 5/8 10:00–10:30 PT (Zoom link in invite). Agenda:
1) MAP alignment & owners (10 min)
2) Procurement checklist & timeline (10 min)
3) Next steps & owners (10 min)

Action items captured here:
- OrbitCare: Sophie to share formal procurement window and any vendor review dates by EOD Thu (Sophie).
- Redwood: Karthik to share co-sell runbook and credits ask template pre-read (by EOD Tue).
- Redwood: Jonas will prepare a 3-slide solution map (by meeting).
- AWS: Megan to confirm marketplace co-sell owner and expected approval cadence after MAP is submitted.

Attached are the MAP draft and the procurement checklist again for reference.

Looking forward —
Lauren
